tags: Chat, calls, files and AI agents for your group, encrypted end to end
signedEvents.content:
KithMoot is a private room for your group: chat, voice and video calls,
screen sharing and files, with AI agents taking part as members on the same
terms as people. Everything is encrypted end to end.

There is no account to make and no company in the middle. A room is a link:
whoever holds it is in, and nobody else can read it. Rooms travel over Nostr
relays, so no operator holds the guest list or the room state.

The Android app rings for calls while it is closed, answers from the lock
screen, and works with headset and car buttons to answer, reject and hang
up. The same rooms open in the browser and on Mac, Windows and Linux.

Free and open source. Works without Google Play services; no Firebase, no
analytics.

Pair Spry once, then use KithMoot’s normal Call button in a conversation or group. The app obtains and renews per-device relay access automatically, without entering TURN usernames or passwords.

For private home calls, each person needs their own reachable paired Spry node and the matching ForgeSworn Archipelago update. A third participant’s VPS can be offline. A publicly reachable Spry can also serve guests without a node. See the [Spry installation guide](https://github.com/forgesworn/archipelago-apps/blob/main/apps/spry/README.md).

Android 0.6.111, version code 134. Production certificate and preview signing lineage retained. APK SHA-256: `28dcd327f6f00a4f652d2b549388ed6323112eb87de07df85ba908277a244068`.

All 17 hosted Android release checks passed. Local protocol/app tests, release lint, production packaging and signature checks passed. All 787 ZIP payload entries match the tested unsigned input. Physical no-Play GrapheneOS audio/video, the installed bundle and independent home-broadband acceptance remain separate gates; no phone was installed or active call interrupted by this release work.
